_comment: Request payloads configure.nu sends, asserted against the server's own /api-docs/openapi.json by the vm-jellyfin test. Jellyfin deserialises with System.Text.Json, which ignores unknown keys instead of rejecting them, so a renamed field would silently stop being applied. Renamed routes and missing response fields already fail loudly when the reconciler runs. /Library/VirtualFolders takes name, collectionType and paths as query parameters, so its create call is not covered here. Keep in sync when editing configure.nu.
